verdict.rationale: Gitleaks scans git repos, directories, files, and stdin for secrets "and whatever else you wanna throw at it" [gitleaks-gh-17]. That makes its scanning content-agnostic, so it can be pointed at a project in any language [gitleaks-gh-9, gitleaks-gh-10, gitleaks-gh-11]. However, it only detects secrets: the evidence shows no language-aware analysis and no package-ecosystem or dependency-manifest support, and custom rules [gitleaks-gh-5] are the only way to extend coverage. Missing for 10: documented language or package-ecosystem coverage, dependency/manifest scanning, and independent corroboration of detection accuracy across languages.
